notes: 4K re-render of the v1 framing, NOT of v2 (Y-SSIM against v1 0.835, against v2 0.638). Two things differ from v1 beyond resolution and must be signed off before swapping: (a) 121 frames at 24 fps instead of 152 at 30 fps, so the scroll scrub has ~20% fewer sample points; (b) the fade-up-from-black opening is gone - v1 frame 0001 is pure black and rises over ~12 frames, v3 frame 0001 already shows the lit silhouette (mean luma 32.4) and dips slightly before revealing. The 2560 tier is new and is the point of this version: it only pays off once the player sizes its canvas by devicePixelRatio (see cdn-swap-checklist.md). Frame filenames match v1/v2 so the tier swap stays a one-line baseUrl change, but frameCount must go 150 -> 121.
